exposure: incorporation of refugees into the Israeli medical system
cohort: All African immigrants who delivered in a tertiary referral center in Israel between January 2018 and September 2019, compared to a native Israeli population
finding: Although perinatal outcomes have not substantially improved with the incorporation of a refugee population into a healthcare system, some progress has been achieved in certain perinatal parameters.
gest_age: Preterm deliveries were stratified as <37 weeks, <34 weeks, and <28 weeks.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight <2000 g was significantly higher among refugees.
